scope: Retrieval descriptions for declared skill options only; not verified robot capabilities or numerical controller parameters.

navigate_to_object.description_en: Move the robot near a grounded object. If a lifted payload is already held, carry it along without releasing it.
examples: Visit the sideboard, then return to the kettle.
Carry the already held kettle to the cabinet.
not_equivalent: place or release the carried object

navigate_to_location.description_en: Move the robot to a grounded room, waypoint or destination pose, rather than to an object instance.
examples: Move to the provided destination waypoint.
not_equivalent: object-centered navigation without a location binding

adjust_body_height.description_en: Raise or lower the robot body to a specified height while keeping a stable base.
examples: Lower the robot body to the given height.
not_equivalent: move the robot to another room

position_arm_for_object.description_en: Prepare the arm for an object or support surface before grasping or placement. This preparation does not itself acquire or release an object.
examples: Prepare the arm to grasp the kettle.
Prepare the arm to place the held kettle on the cabinet.
not_equivalent: joint trajectory validated on a real robot

grasp_object.description_en: Acquire a graspable object with an empty gripper after approaching and arm preparation. Change the object from unheld to held; this is not continuous holding or lifting.
examples: Take hold of the kettle.
Pick up and lift the kettle: grasp is the acquisition part.
not_equivalent: keep holding an already held object

lift_held_object.description_en: Lift an already grasped object away from its support before carrying it. The gripper must already hold the object.
examples: Lift the kettle already in the gripper.
Pick up and lift the kettle: lift follows grasp.
not_equivalent: keep holding without an additional lift

place_object_on_surface.description_en: Place a currently held object on a grounded support surface and release it. Approach the surface and prepare the arm when needed.
examples: Set the held kettle on the sideboard and release it.

place_object_in_container.description_en: Put a currently held object inside a grounded container and release it.
examples: Place the held apple inside the bowl.

release_object.description_en: Open the gripper to release a held object only after safe contact or a receiving relationship is established.
examples: Release the object after its support is established.

open_articulated_object.description_en: Open a grounded door, drawer or articulated container using its controllable handle or joint.
examples: Open the drawer using its handle.

close_articulated_object.description_en: Close a grounded door, drawer or articulated container.
examples: Close the drawer.

push_object.description_en: Push a pushable object along a specified grounded direction and distance.
examples: Push the box in the specified direction.

pull_object.description_en: Pull a pullable object along a specified grounded direction and distance.
examples: Pull the box toward the robot.

press_control.description_en: Press or operate a grounded button, switch or controllable component.
examples: Press the appliance button.

pour_into_container.description_en: Pour the declared contents of a currently held source container into a grounded receiving container.
examples: Pour water from the held kettle into the cup.
not_equivalent: place the whole kettle into a container

handover_object.description_en: Give a currently held object to a localized receiving person and release it when accepted.
examples: Hand the held plate to the receiving person.

inspect_object.description_en: Observe an object from an appropriate viewpoint to verify identity, state or relation.
examples: Inspect the cup to check its contents.

walk_omnidirectional_velocity.description_en: Walk with commanded planar forward/lateral velocity and yaw rate in an explicitly supplied frame for a bounded duration; this does not itself navigate to a scene object.
examples: Walk with the supplied velocity command and duration.

turn_by_stepping.description_en: Turn the robot by the requested yaw using stepping turning; direction and frame must be supplied.
examples: Perform the requested stepping turn.

turn_in_place.description_en: Turn the robot by the requested yaw using in-place turning; direction and frame must be supplied.
examples: Perform the requested in-place turn.

bend_and_lift_object.description_en: Coordinate bending, establishing a supported grasp or embrace, and lifting the target; unlike lift_held_object, the target need not already be held.
examples: Bend down and lift the specified object.
not_equivalent: lift an already grasped object only
assume a quadruped supports a humanoid controller

reach_and_grasp_object.description_en: Coordinate reaching toward a target and acquiring a grasp. This option includes grasp acquisition, not just arm preparation.
examples: Reach toward the specified object and grasp it with the selected hand.

reach_and_place_object.description_en: Coordinate reaching with a held object and placing it at a supplied target pose with confirmed support before release.
aliases: reach toward a target point and place
examples: Reach to the supplied placement pose and place the held object.

reset_lower_body.description_en: Return the lower body to its explicitly supplied initial-state reference.
examples: Restore the lower body to its supplied reference state.

reset_upper_body.description_en: Return the upper body to its explicitly supplied initial-state reference.
examples: Restore the upper body to its supplied reference state.

reset_manipulation_state.description_en: Restore an explicitly identified manipulation component to a supplied reference state. The source does not specify whether this means the hand, gripper or arm; clarify the component.
examples: Restore the specified component to its provided initial-state reference.
not_equivalent: release an object as an implicit side effect

place_object_at_pose.description_en: Place a held object at a supplied position and orientation with a verified support relation, then progressively release it.
examples: Place the held object at the supplied position and orientation.
not_equivalent: assume a support geometry or force limit

hold_and_stabilize_object.description_en: Maintain an existing grasp or fixation, object pose and required holding relation against disturbances within verified limits; this is not a new grasp or lift.
examples: Keep the bottle fixed with the selected hand while another action operates on its cap.

move_end_effector_free_space.description_en: Move the selected hand or a payload already held by that hand to a supplied pose while avoiding unintended contact; no new grasp is implied.
aliases: move held payload in free space
examples: Move the selected hand to the supplied pregrasp pose without contact.

controlled_release_object.description_en: Progressively unload, open the selected hand and break contact only after support or a receiving grasp has been verified. The source marks this as requiring iterative development.
examples: Gradually release the object after its support is confirmed.
not_equivalent: assume the other hand is holding

translate_with_contact_constraint.description_en: Translate the target under a supplied contact-mode, path or axis, and force/torque constraint. Do not infer missing motion geometry or limits.
examples: Translate the target along the supplied constrained trajectory.
not_equivalent: invent a contact force or axis
guaranteed completion of an entire composite task

rotate_with_contact_constraint.description_en: Rotate the target under a supplied contact-mode, path or axis, and force/torque constraint. Do not infer missing motion geometry or limits.
examples: Rotate the target along the supplied constrained trajectory.
not_equivalent: invent a contact force or axis
guaranteed completion of an entire composite task

follow_surface_contact.description_en: Follow a supplied tangential path on a surface while maintaining the specified normal contact and force constraints.
examples: Follow the supplied wiping path while maintaining the required contact.
not_equivalent: claim the surface is clean without inspection
